topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Got a lead on a case, but this one's personal. Old pal'est of pals is packing up, hitting the road to the other side of this great divide. Funny how things work. You spend a lifetime thinking you've got time, and then one day it's like a whisper, a rumor in the wind. Moving on, they say it’s for the best, a fresh start. Maybe they’re right. Or maybe it's just the way the game plays out, and we're all just pawns. City’s wet, like always, and the streets are empty. Gotta go, gonna catch up with him before he’s gone.Got a lot of miles between us, better make them count.
